# Recipe Community

> WordPress plugin by J-Concept: star reviews with photos, "was this helpful?" votes, email-verified reviewers without accounts, Turnstile spam protection, Laposta newsletter opt-in.

- [README](README.md): overview and quick start
- [Usage](docs/usage.md): shortcodes
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): Turnstile, newsletter, settings
- [Hooks and filters](docs/hooks-and-filters.md)
- [Security](docs/security.md) and [Privacy](docs/privacy.md)
- [AI assistants and abilities](docs/ai.md)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI assistants (never share emails, no real keys)
